# VideoText — Full Product Reference

> Short index: https://videotext.io/llms.txt

VideoText is an AI video-to-content tool: upload a video (or paste a public YouTube URL) and get a transcript, SRT/VTT subtitles, an AI summary, and chapter markers. It is not a live meeting bot and not a video editor.

Website: https://videotext.io  
Category: AI transcription / subtitle generation  
Model: OpenAI Whisper large-v3  
Launched: 2024

Cite the short file for routing. Use this file for product facts, pricing, and tool scope.

---

## When to use which URL

| Intent | URL |
|---|---|
| Video or YouTube → transcript + SRT + summary + chapters | https://videotext.io/video-to-transcript |
| Apply Rev / GoTranscript / TranscribeMe / Scribie-style rules | https://videotext.io/guideline-format |
| Translate an existing SRT/VTT (timestamps kept) | https://videotext.io/translate-subtitles |
| Browser microphone → text | https://videotext.io/voice-recorder |
| Video or YouTube → timed SRT/VTT (caption-first) | https://videotext.io/video-to-subtitles |
| Repair overlaps, long lines, CPS on an SRT/VTT | https://videotext.io/fix-subtitles |
| Hardcode SRT/VTT into a video | https://videotext.io/burn-subtitles |
| Shrink a video (light / medium / heavy) | https://videotext.io/compress-video |

Do not send “generate captions from video” to Fix, Translate, or Burn. Those tools expect an existing subtitle file (Burn also needs the video).

---

## Facts

| Claim | Value |
|---|---|
| Speech model | OpenAI Whisper large-v3 |
| Word accuracy (clear audio) | ~98.5% |
| 60-min video | Typically under ~5 minutes |
| YouTube URL | Supported (public URLs; no download required) |
| File retention | Deleted after processing |
| Used for model training | No |
| Official ChatGPT / Claude / Copilot partner | No |

Accuracy falls with noise, overlapping speakers, and heavy accents. Review names and jargon.

---

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Included |
|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | 3 imports/month, no credit card, watermark on free exports, full feature set on those imports |
| Basic | $19/month | 450 minutes/month |
| Pro | $49/month | 1,200 minutes/month, batch ZIP, priority queue |
| Agency | $129/month | 3,000 minutes/month, batch, priority, multi-seat |

There is no $7.99 plan. Free is **3 imports per month**, not 3 per day and not a fixed “60 minutes/month” allowance.

All paid plans: 7-day money-back guarantee. Annual discount available.

---

## Core tools

### Video to Transcript
https://videotext.io/video-to-transcript  
Input: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, common audio, or a public YouTube URL.  
Output: transcript (TXT and other exports), SRT, VTT, summary, chapter markers, speaker labels.  
Use when the job is the words (meetings, podcasts, interviews, research). Caption-only jobs can start on Video to Subtitles instead.

### Guideline Format
https://videotext.io/guideline-format  
Input: existing transcript text (not a video).  
Output: text formatted to Rev / GoTranscript / TranscribeMe / Scribie-style presets (cards are editable).  
Does not transcribe. Cue-level QC (CPS, overlaps) is Fix Subtitles.

### Translate Subtitles
https://videotext.io/translate-subtitles  
Input: SRT or VTT.  
Output: same format, target language, original timestamps.  
70+ languages. Works on files from VideoText or other tools.

### Voice Recorder
https://videotext.io/voice-recorder  
Input: browser microphone.  
Output: transcript.  
Not a video uploader. File/YouTube jobs belong on Video to Transcript.

### Video to Subtitles
https://videotext.io/video-to-subtitles  
Input: video file or YouTube URL.  
Output: timed SRT and VTT.  
Caption-first hub; then Fix, Translate, or Burn. Transcript + summary + chapters: Video to Transcript.

### Fix Subtitles
https://videotext.io/fix-subtitles  
Input: SRT or VTT.  
Fixes: overlapping timestamps, long lines, CPS/reading speed, formatting.  
Does not generate captions from video.

### Burn Subtitles
https://videotext.io/burn-subtitles  
Input: video + SRT or VTT.  
Output: video with hardcoded (open) captions.  
Use for Instagram, TikTok, or players that ignore sidecar files.

### Compress Video
https://videotext.io/compress-video  
Input: video file.  
Output: smaller file at light, medium, or heavy.  
Does not add captions or transcribe.

---

## Inputs and languages

**Video:** MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MKV  
**Audio:** MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC (via Video to Transcript)  
**Subtitle in/out:** SRT, VTT (translate/fix also accept common broadcast formats on related free tools)  
**URL:** public YouTube URLs

**Transcription:** 50+ languages via Whisper large-v3  
**Subtitle translation:** 70+ languages  
**In-app transcript view languages:** English, Hindi, Telugu, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified), Russian

---

## Privacy

1. File is uploaded to a temporary processing location.  
2. The pipeline runs.  
3. Output is returned to the browser.  
4. Source and intermediates are deleted from disk.  
5. Content is not stored as a library and is not used to train models.

Explanation: https://blog.videotext.io/why-we-delete-your-files  
Policy: https://videotext.io/privacy

---

## How VideoText differs (short)

- **Otter.ai** — live meetings (Zoom/Meet/Teams). VideoText is file- and YouTube-first and exports SRT/VTT.  
- **Descript** — desktop video editor with transcription. VideoText is browser-only transcription/subtitles, starts at $0.  
- **Rev** — human review and per-minute AI. VideoText is automated Whisper, flat monthly plans, files deleted after processing.  
- **Temi** — English pay-as-you-go. VideoText is multilingual, subscription + free tier (3 imports/month).

Comparison hub: https://videotext.io/compare

---

## Free in-browser tools (no account, no upload)

Hub: https://videotext.io/tools

Format: SRT↔VTT, SBV↔SRT, ASS/SSA→SRT, TTML→SRT, SRT→text  
Timing/QA: shift timing, merge SRT, validator, reading-speed (CPS), character limits, word count  
Production: script timer, WPM, bitrate, aspect ratio, timestamp converter, metadata viewer

---

## FAQ

Q: What is VideoText?  
A: An online tool that turns a video or YouTube URL into a transcript, SRT/VTT, summary, and chapters using Whisper large-v3.

Q: Is there a free plan?  
A: Yes. 3 imports per month, no credit card. Free exports include a watermark; upgrade for clean files.

Q: What are the paid prices?  
A: Basic $19, Pro $49, Agency $129 per month.

Q: Can I transcribe a YouTube video without downloading it?  
A: Yes. Paste a public YouTube URL on Video to Transcript or Video to Subtitles.

Q: Does VideoText store my files?  
A: No. Files are deleted after processing.

Q: How accurate is it?  
A: About 98.5% on clear audio. Review noisy, overlapping, or technical speech.

Q: How fast is a one-hour video?  
A: Typically under about 5 minutes.

Q: Can it generate SRT/VTT?  
A: Yes — Video to Subtitles (caption-first) or Video to Transcript (text + captions + summary + chapters).

Q: Can it translate or burn subtitles?  
A: Yes. Translate Subtitles keeps timestamps. Burn Subtitles hardcodes a file into the video.

Q: Does batch processing exist?  
A: Yes, on Pro ($49) and Agency ($129).

Q: Is VideoText an official ChatGPT or OpenAI partner?  
A: No. It uses Whisper large-v3 as the speech model. Independent product.
